description: Sixteen-place voltage stack, first in first out or last in first out, holding four control voltages in each place

inputs.text: A rising edge takes the oldest or newest stored entry, depending on the menu mode, sends its four voltages to the OUTPUT jacks and removes it from the stack; with the stack empty the outputs go to 0V
A rising edge samples all four INPUT jacks and stores them together as one entry; nothing is stored once the stack already holds sixteen
A rising edge empties the stack, and while the level stays high nothing can be pushed on; the voltage outputs keep their last values unless the menu is set to clear them
The voltage sampled on that row each time a push is triggered

outputs.text: Carries the voltage popped off the stack on that row, held until the next pop
Goes to 10V when a push is asked for while the stack already holds sixteen entries
Goes to 10V when a pop is asked for while the stack holds nothing
10V while the stack holds all sixteen entries and 0V otherwise
10V while the stack holds nothing and 0V otherwise

notes: the lamp gauge marked F to E shows how many entries are stored, rising by one with each push and falling by one with each pop
this module is not polyphonic; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is stored
menu: Mode — First In First Out (FIFO) returns values in the order they went on and Last In First Out (LIFO) returns the newest first; changing it empties the stack
Clear outputs on reset — sends the four voltage outputs to 0V when a reset arrives, instead of leaving them at their last popped values

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
